definition_or_allowed_wording: A delivery grouping in source systems; not itself the audit decision object.
prohibited_inference: Do not equate with a deployment or snapshot.

definition_or_allowed_wording: The approved service-bounded object identified by closure_id and policy_version.
prohibited_inference: Do not aggregate across services without an explicit higher-level model.

definition_or_allowed_wording: An environment-specific execution of one ReleaseDecision.
prohibited_inference: Do not collapse canary blue-green or multi-environment events into one timestamp.

definition_or_allowed_wording: No declared contract failure is observed at the cutoff under the stated candidate-coverage and observation assumptions.
prohibited_inference: Does not guarantee that no later incident will occur.

definition_or_allowed_wording: An immutable as-of audit record in one linear supersession chain.
prohibited_inference: Do not overwrite or silently branch prior snapshots.

definition_or_allowed_wording: The policy-bounded interval after each Deployment that must end before closed_as_of.
prohibited_inference: Not the same as data extraction cutoff or maximum reporting delay.

definition_or_allowed_wording: The timestamp up to which evidence is admitted to one snapshot.
Separate incident events with explicit precedence and censoring rules.
prohibited_inference: Do not substitute one timestamp for another.

definition_or_allowed_wording: An author-coded illustrative correspondence between retained statements and contract categories.
prohibited_inference: Not case conformance or field validation.

definition_or_allowed_wording: The reference implementation conformed for the declared fixtures and tests.
prohibited_inference: Not proof that the specification is complete or superior.

definition_or_allowed_wording: Invalid latest declared-exception decisions divided by all latest decisions declared exception; denominator zero yields not_applicable.
prohibited_inference: Do not call the denominator effective exceptions.

definition_or_allowed_wording: Report required-field completeness and candidate-coverage completeness separately from outcome metrics.
prohibited_inference: Do not hide poor records by excluding invalid releases from all reporting.
